what: P16: pi 1.5.2 in the stage's sandbox image (linux/amd64, run locally under Docker with the image's own pi and Node), launched as piLaunch does (PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR, PI_OFFLINE=1, PI_SKIP_VERSION_CHECK, PI_TELEMETRY=0, HOME=/root, --mode rpc, --no-approve, the profile's settings.json), with a scripted stand-in for the model (scripts/settings-spike/fakeModel.mjs: Anthropic Messages, tool calls from the prompt's CALL lines) and the spike's public probe as the MCP server. A probe extension stood in for t3's (the profile allows only t3's) to read what a tool_call hook can see

piOfflineStopsMcp.detail: with PI_OFFLINE=1 pi connected (initialize, tools/list, GET stream, tools/call, DELETE at exit). Keep PI_OFFLINE; nothing to drop

readsMcpJsonFromAgentDir.detail: the only mcp.json was in $PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR (HOME=/root had none); its server connected

headerVariableExpands.detail: Authorization: Bearer ${T3FLARE_TOOL_HANDLE} arrived as 'Bearer spike-… (34 chars)', the test value's length

heldCallFinishes.detail: timeout 900: a call held 870 s and one held 960 s both finished; pi sends a progressToken and the probe sent notifications/progress every 15 s, which reset pi's timeout (pi docs: 'Progress notifications reset it'). The relay must send progress (or keep under 900 s) on its card waits

bashSeesHandle.detail: pi's bash printed handle:set:34 and env lists the variable: the accepted residual of ADR-0028 (D4)

toolSourceLabel.answer: the tool_call event carries only type, toolName, toolCallId and input; pi.getAllTools() gives the MCP tool sourceInfo {path: 'builtin:mcp', source: 'builtin', scope: 'temporary', origin: 'top-level'}, namespace {name: 'mcp__<server>', aliases: ['<server>']}, the server's annotations and exposure. A Patch can return early for tools whose sourceInfo.path is 'builtin:mcp' (as t3's extension already checks 'builtin:tool-search' for tool_search)

forkLaunchHasNoMcp.detail: with --no-extensions (the fork launch) the tool is 'not found' and the probe saw no connection from that case

protocolAndCapabilities.answer: pi 1.5.2 initializes 2025-11-25 with capabilities {roots: {}} (no elicitation), clientInfo {name: pi, version: 1.5.2}, User-Agent undici, Sec-Fetch-Mode: cors, no Origin and no Sec-Fetch-Site; it opens a GET stream and sends DELETE at exit

elicitationFallback.answer: with no elicitation declared, the form and URL tools answered their text fallbacks (D12: pi gets the link in the result)
